user.title: Buspro gateway configuration
user.description: Enter IP address and port number of the gateway.

udp_port_unavailable.title: HDL Buspro cannot open UDP port {port}
udp_port_unavailable.description: Home Assistant could not open UDP port {port}, so nothing is sent to or received from the HDL bus. Usually another program uses the port: HDL Buspro Setup Tool on this computer, another integration or a second Home Assistant instance. Close it and restart Home Assistant. In Docker, run the container with host networking so that the gateway's broadcasts reach it.

scan.name: Scan HDL bus
scan.description: Find HDL Buspro devices, their channels and the names stored in them. Read-only: nothing is switched. Takes about a minute; call it with "return response" to see the result.

rounds.name: Search rounds
rounds.description: How many times to repeat the device search. One round reaches about 87% of devices.

interval.name: Round length
interval.description: Seconds per search round. Devices answer within about 5 seconds.

read_names.name: Read channel names
read_names.description: Read the name of every output and curtain channel.

read_mac.name: Read MAC addresses
read_mac.description: Read each device's MAC address, which stays the same when its address changes.

test_channel.name: Test HDL channel
test_channel.description: Switch a channel, curtain or universal switch directly on the bus and report what the device answered, to check it is the right one before adding it. This switches the real load. A pulse turns the channel on for a few seconds and then restores its previous level.

address.name: Device address
address.description: Subnet ID and device ID, e.g. 1.89.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Channel, curtain or universal switch number.

action.name: Action
action.description: Outputs: on, off, level, pulse. Curtains: open, close, stop. Universal switches: on, off.

duration.name: Pulse length
duration.description: Seconds the channel stays on during a pulse.

send_message.name: Send HDL telegram
send_message.description: Send any telegram to a device on the bus. For advanced use: a wrong telegram can change the device.

address.name: Device address
address.description: Subnet ID and device ID as a list, e.g. [1, 74].

operate_code.name: Operate code
operate_code.description: Operate code as two bytes, e.g. [4, 78] for 0x044E.

activate_scene.name: Activate HDL scene
activate_scene.description: Activate a scene stored in a device.

address.name: Device address
address.description: Subnet ID and device ID as a list, e.g. [1, 74].

scene_address.name: Scene
scene_address.description: Area number and scene number, e.g. [3, 5].

set_universal_switch.name: Set HDL universal switch
set_universal_switch.description: Turn a universal switch of a device on or off.

address.name: Device address
address.description: Subnet ID and device ID as a list, e.g. [1, 74].

status.name: Status
status.description: 1 turns it on, 0 turns it off.
